fullContentHtml:
Jharkhand JSSC 10+2 Inter Level JILCCE Online Form 2026 – Re-Open – Full Details

Jharkhand Staff Selection Commission (JSSC) has released the notification for the Post of 10+2 Inter Level JILCCE. This recruitment has been issued for 326 posts. Online applying process for Jharkhand JSSC 10+2 Inter Level JILCCE Recruitment 2026 has started from 05 August 2026 & the candidates can apply till 30 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for Jharkhand JSSC 10+2 Inter Level JILCCE Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

How to Apply Online

  1. Click the official application link provided below.
  2. Register with your basic details (Name, Email, Mobile).
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address information.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  5. Pay the application fee online (if applicable).
  6. Submit the form and save the confirmation receipt.

Important Links

  • Apply Online
  • Download Form Re Open Notice
  • Download Notification/ Brochure
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is Jharkhand JSSC 10+2 Inter Level JILCCE Online Form 2026 – Re-Open?

Jharkhand JSSC 10+2 Inter Level JILCCE Online Form 2026 – Re-Open is an official government recruitment / examination notification. Complete details including eligibility, important dates, and direct links are provided above.

Where can I find the official link?

The official link is: https://jssc.jharkhand.gov.in/

How to apply online?

Click on the Apply Online link given above, register on the official portal, fill the form, upload documents and pay the fee before the last date.
